# CardDAV request batching is sequential and separate from the local bulk-add threshold

The batch preference defaults to 500 and is clamped to at least one. Three sync callers splice pending hrefs and await each batch. The REPORT helper accepts the provided batch without its own size limit. V2 stores its final token only after every batch, but earlier batches may already have changed local cards if a later request fails. The separate more-than-25-card threshold controls local bulk adds, not request size. Batch-size-one tasks reuse state assertions and explicitly do not prove request cardinality; logging is not a request-count assertion. No sync or performance run was performed.

Scope: CardDAV sync requests and tests.
